status: approved isolated GPU runtime installed; 4000 total language updates completed; frozen fresh writing exam failed; checkpoint remains experimental and is not connected to Hive chat
purpose: Test whether a broader language corpus and a larger random-start model improve English continuations before B3 dialogue teaching.

hardware_observed.gpu_training_capability: verified MPS forward/backward, numerical parity and complete-step benchmark

proposed_runtime.installation: owner explicitly approved the isolated exception, recorded in CLAUDE.md
proposed_runtime.weights: our own random initialization; no downloaded pretrained weights

corpus.source: original train and validation TXT files with complete endoftext-delimited stories
corpus.budgets: 90 percent train source, 10 percent official validation source
corpus.splits: train source stays in train; official validation stories split by normalized content hash into validation and test
corpus.deduplication: global exact and normalized document deduplication before tokenization
corpus.integrity: save admitted prefix hashes, offsets, split hashes, and expected whole-file hashes; a partial import does not verify a whole-file hash
corpus.truth_status: synthetic fiction for language learning; no reviewed B3 facts
corpus.further_scale: increase data only after the bounded pilot and contamination checks; a prefix pilot is not representative of the complete dataset

numerical_reference.source: existing manual-gradient NumPy Transformer and AdamW
numerical_reference.optimizer_comparison: Use identical saved gradients to isolate optimizer parity. Separately compare autograd gradients and resulting logits/loss after a complete update.
numerical_reference.investigated_rounding_difference: Two CPU key-bias entries exceeded the parameter tolerance after a combined autograd/AdamW update because tiny float32 residuals are amplified by AdamW epsilon. A common attention key bias cancels mathematically. Every other parameter and the resulting logits/loss pass the unchanged tolerances; the difference is explicitly covered in regression tests and the local parity report.
numerical_reference.failure_action: investigate and report; never silently relax tolerances or proceed to a long training run

proposed_language_model.version: separate GPU language model and checkpoint contract; legacy scratch checkpoints unchanged
proposed_language_model.architecture: pre-layernorm causal Transformer, learned position embeddings, ReLU feedforward, untied output head
proposed_language_model.tokenizer: UTF-8 bytes 0 through 255 plus explicit end-of-document token 256; new tokenizer version

hive_context_measurement.exclusions: user text, lesson content, history, role framing and generation budget
hive_context_measurement.implication: the language pilot is not a full Hive conversation model; integration needs a separate measured context and dialogue design

proposed_language_model.precision: float32 first; mixed precision requires a separate measured decision
proposed_language_model.compatibility: exceeds the existing CPU scratch model limits; cannot be loaded by the current scratch HTTP adapter

bounded_experiment.benchmark_before_training: measure complete optimizer updates, device memory and wall time; reduce batch/context or stop if caps cannot be met
bounded_experiment.validation_selection: token-weighted next-token loss on fixed validation windows, including the random baseline; keep best complete state
bounded_experiment.test_isolation: test split and language_exam.json do not select checkpoints or supply training targets
bounded_experiment.report: record actual tokens, updates, wall time, throughput, peak memory, random baseline, validation curve, selected step, raw test continuations and manual review
bounded_experiment.stopping: stop at the first update, token, wall or memory cap; save actual progress without declaring success

quality_milestones: Readable English continuations on separately authored fixed prompts and untouched held-out stories. A lower prediction loss alone does not pass this milestone.
Teacher-reviewed multi-turn dialogue training, uncertainty examples, B3 source references and corrections, followed by a separate task exam.
Hive integration with measured instruction/history/lesson context budget, learned turn endings, and compatible checkpoint and response protocol.
Only after dialogue qualification, structured calls to the existing four public diagnostics with independent argument and factual-result checks.
limits: This plan and its parameter count do not establish useful language or conversation capability.
TinyStories tests a narrow synthetic story domain; success does not establish general chat, B3 expertise or tool reliability.
No training occurs just by saving a conversation or a lesson.
No wallet actions, production node connections, consensus changes, external compute spending or publication are part of this experiment.

completed_local_stage.fresh_exam_result: failed provisional writing gate; raw text and scores preserved
completed_local_stage.review_caveat: Readability2 requires only one grammatical sentence and includes borderline judgments; it does not denote a coherent complete output.
completed_local_stage.audit_result: All 4,000 sampled batches, RNG states and optimizer counters reproduced; independent CPU validation differs by 1.27e-7; original scratch artifacts unchanged.
completed_local_stage.hive_ui: Training tab reads local saved reports; it does not run training or connect the new checkpoint to chat
completed_local_stage.next_requirement: improve independently examined free generation before dialogue, serving and B3/tool qualification; used exams become exploratory
